Rest at the inn needs one new Worker route file, small edits to three existing Worker files, and edits to four frontend files. I read `PRD.md`, `SETUP.md`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` and the relevant code. I changed nothing.

The PRD (US-09, §6.2) has an inn in the town/shop flow but no rest endpoint. `levelup.ts` and `shop.ts` are the closest existing patterns, so the new route follows them.

## Worker (`worker/`)

1. **`src/routes/inn.ts`** (new file)
   - Export `innRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /rest`, modelled on `levelup.ts`.
   - Parse `InnRestBody` and return 400 if `sessionId` or `characterId` is missing.
   - Load the character with `getCharacter`; return 404 if it's missing.
   - Load the session with `loadSession`, falling back to `rebuildSession`. Return 400 if `session.inCombat` is true.
   - Return 400 if `hp >= max_hp`, so the player isn't charged for nothing.
   - Return 400 `Not enough gold. Need Ng, have Mg.` if `gold < INN_REST_COST`. This matches the wording in `shop.ts:52`.
   - Call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - INN_REST_COST })`. A single UPDATE keeps the HP and gold change atomic.
   - Insert into `adventure_log` with actor `'system'`, as `levelup.ts:42` does.
   - Push a history turn onto `session.history` and call `saveSession`. This keeps the AI DM aware of the rest.
   - Return `{ success, cost, updatedCharacter, narrative }`.

2. **`src/index.ts`**
   - Add `import { innRoutes } from './routes/inn.js'` near line 12.
   - Add `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes)` near line 48.
   - CORS needs no change. `POST` is already allowed.

3. **`src/types/index.ts`**
   - Add `InnRestBody { sessionId; characterId }`, next to `LevelUpBody` (line 168).
   - Add `export const INN_REST_COST = 10` in the "D&D Rule Constants" section (line 174 onward). The cost is my suggestion. A flat 10g works against the starting `gold = 50` set in `createCharacter` (`services/character.ts:50`). If you want it to scale with level, that is the one design choice to make.

4. **`src/services/character.ts`** (optional)
   - Add a `restAtInn(db, character)` helper. This keeps the route thin, as `levelUp()` does. `updateCharacter` already accepts `hp` and `gold`, so nothing else is needed.

No migration or seed change is needed. `characters.hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist, and the `adventure_log` insert uses existing columns.

## Frontend (`frontend/src/app/`)

1. **`models/game.models.ts`**
   - Add an `InnRestResponse` type (`success`, `cost`, `updatedCharacter`, `narrative`). I didn't open this file; `game-api.service.ts` imports `Character` and the other types from it.
   - Add `INN_REST_COST`, mirroring the Worker constant, so the UI can show the price and disable the button.

2. **`services/game-api.service.ts`**
   - Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId): Observable<InnRestResponse>` that does `POST ${API_BASE}/api/inn/rest`. Put it in a new "Inn" section beside the Shop block (line 104).

3. **`components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`**
   - Add `restLoading = signal(false)`, as `luLoading` does.
   - Add a `restAtInn()` method modelled on `levelUp()` (line 183):
     - Guard on `restLoading()`.
     - Call `api.restAtInn`.
     - On success, run `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and `pushEntry('system', ...)` with the narrative and cost.
     - On error, show `err?.error?.error` through `pushEntry`. Unlike `levelUp`, which swallows errors, the player needs to see "Not enough gold" or "Already at full health".

4. **`components/game-console/game-console.component.html`**
   - Add a "Rest at Inn (10g)" button in the `.sidebar-actions` block (line 8), next to the Inventory button.
   - Disable it when any of these is true:
     - `restLoading()` is true.
     - `charSvc.inCombat()` is true.
     - `charSvc.character()?.hp === charSvc.character()?.max_hp`.
     - `character.gold < cost`.

Optionally, `game-console.component.css` (not read) may need a style tweak for the button. Add a test for `restAtInn()` in `game-console.component.spec.ts` if you keep specs current.

`CharacterStateService` and `character-sheet` need no changes. `setCharacter` already updates the HP bar (`hpPercent`) and the gold display.
